content: Paulusi Yoota ku Jelusalema
Cwale aba tuna mana oukutaba noo mu ku bambaba feela, sebeli tufuula, mi sebeli tulumba ku Kosi, mi liywaa linakutatamako sebeli tukeela mu Lodesi, okutunda omo sebeli tuta ku Patala.
Cwale aba tuna kuwana esisepe silumbile ku Foenisiya, sebeli tukulongamo ni kuta.
Cwale aba tuna keela mu sibaka no Sipulasi, sebeli tusi yupela ku simoo okuta mu Silia, sebeli tuka fuweka mu Tile, kakuli omo esisepe kame sina kulongola etutu.
Cwale sebeli tuwanamo aiyetwa, ni kwiikala noo amaywaa mutanu ni twiili (7). Mu mebo sebeli aambela Paulusi nji alese okuta ku Jelusalema.

Cwale amaywaa etu aba ana kubwa, sebeli tu funduka okwekeza omusipili wetu ni kutu sindeketa onje, naa moyo oo naanoo, ni ku tulita konji aba ana kutu siisa omulenen̄i, sebeli tu kubama ni manwi ba likamba okulapela ni ku kulana omnjili ni munjili okuwaba.
Cwale sebeli tukulonga mu sisepe, onyene sebeli aukela ku mundi.
Cwale aba tuna kumana omusipil wetu okutunda mu Tile, sebeli tuta ku Tolemaisi ni kukeeta aasikupumena ni kwiikala noo eliywaa limweya.

Eliywaa lina ku tatamako sebeli tu funduka nuukakeela mu Sesaaliya, mi sebeli twiingena mu ndoo ya Filipi omwaambi no mikopano, woyo ona kutenda omunjili noao mutanu ni twiili (7) ni kwikala kwa yonyene.
Kame ana kwikala naanaye anee nwa sizana no kwaakwaliwa, ana ku nuhanga.
Aba tuna kwikalamo amaywaa mbicana, sebeli kwiiya omunuhi no litina lya Agabusi ona ku tunda ku Judeya.

Cwale aba ana kukeela kwaaci, sebeli okununga olukanda lwa Paulusi ku maoko ni ku makondoo ni kwamba nji, “Eesi, so kame esinaambiwa ku Mebo No Kukena nji, aendisi no Majuda mu Jelusalema mwasanungele omunya lukanda olu, ni ku mubeeka mu maata ano macaba.”
Cwale aba tuna kuyupa ngeso, aaci naanu sebeli tu mukumbela nji alese okukambama okuta ku Jelusalema.

Cwale Paulusi sebeli otambula nji, “Iikene aba mulila ni kucola omucima wange? Kakuli mene kame ni kutukisite kasa okwingena mu tolongo feela, kono simba okufa ku Jelusalema mulibaka no litina lya Mbumu Jesu.”
Sebeli okana okukolwisiwa kwaaci, sebeli toondoka ni kwamba nji, “Ku tendahale eso sisingwa kwa Mbumu.”
Munyima no maywaa ao, sebeli tuku tukiseta okuta ku Jelusalema.
Cwale naiyetwa anjili ana ku tunda ku Sesaaliya sebeli ata naaci, oku tutwala ku ndoo ya Nasoni, omwiyetwa no kale na ku Sipulasi, oko tuna ku fanena okwikala.
Paulusi yo Potela Jakobo
Cwale aba tuna ku keela mu Jelusalema, aasikupumena sebeli atu tambula wino mu ku wabelelwa.
Eliywaa lina ku tatamako Paulusi ota naaci kwa Jakobo, mi onje akulu sebeli aikalako.
Munyima no kwakeeta, sebeli otalusa wino einu eyo Nyambe ana tende kwaasimacaba mu musebezi waye.

Cwale aba ana kuyupa eyo, sebeli akanyisa Nyambe. Mi sebeli aamba kwa yonyene nji, “Omwabetu, esi omwine nji, aendisi no Majuda aa ana lumele sebeli eikiti no kupula, mi aanu onje kame atukufalelwe omulawo.
Kame anaambelwe eyowe nji wene kame wiyeta aendisi no Majuda onje awo ayoya mwano asimacaba nji afulalele Mushe, okwaambela nji alese okutwala anoo ku mupato simba okukuteka eizo yoo.
Cwale ngasibine saitendahale? Kame saayupe nji nwiyi.
Otenda eyo tukwambela. Kame tukwite alume anee awo ali munji no sepiso noutokwa.

Waashimbe aa alume okakukenise noo, mi waatenekele nji cwale aka beulise emitwi yoo. Cwale aanu onje kame saalimuke nji kakwisa esinjili eso ana yupu kweyo inambiwa mulibaka lyowe kono nji ni wene kame oyoya mu ku tokomela omulawo wa Mushe.
Kono kweeyo no asimacaba ana lumele, kame tunaatumene elin̄olo no mulelo wetu nji kame afanena okukana kweeyo ina tendelwe emilimi, ni ku unyinga, ni kweyo ina owiwa, ni uhule.

Cwale Paulusi sebeli oshimba aalume awo, mi ba liywaa linaku tatamako sebeli okukenisa noo ni kwingena mu ndoo ya Nyambe, okwamba amaywaa no kukenisa koo aba saiyatetetwe ni nubu nai kubiwa eyi no munu ni munu woo.
Okunungiwa Kwa Paulusi mu Ndoo ya Nyambe
Cwale amaywaa mutanu naayili aba ana kwatumela okubwa, aendisi no Majuda na ku Esiya awo ana kumumona mu ndoo ya Nyambe, sebeli asusuweza enyangela ina kukuwana mu kupula, ni ku mulema.

Cwale sebeli akuwa nji, “Alume no Isilaele, komutuse! Uno yokame omutu ona kwiiyetanga aanu onje mu ibaka yonje okulwisa aanu ni mulawo ni sibaka sino, abakulingeso osilita kame Amagelike mu ndoo ya Nyambe, mi na silafaza esibaka sino no kukena.
Kakuli kame ana kumumona oweli yo enda ni Tolofimo Omwiifese mu mulenen̄i, mi sebeli anahana nji Paulusi mwendi namu liti mu ndoo ya Nyambe.
Cwale omulenen̄i onje sebeli oimana amaefe-efe, mi aanu sebeli aituka ba bamweya, okalema Paulusi ni ku mukoka okumutundisa mu ndoo ya Nyambe mi ababo emyelo sebeli iyatiliwa.
Cwale aba ana kweteka nji amwibaye, eliywi sebeli liiya ku mwendisi no masole no Maloma nji Jelusalema yonje naimana ni mufilifili.
Mu nako imweya sebeli oshimba amasole na shebuluki oo, ni kwiitukela kwa onyene, cwale aba anakumona omwendisi ni masole, sebeli alesela okumufula.
Cwale omwendisi sebeli osheteta ni kulema Paulusi, ni ku laela nji anungiwe ni mawenge ayili. okubinda aibangute eyaye, nji yokame anyine, neeyo ana tende.
Anjili mu nyangela sebeli akuweleza sinu simweya, anjili sindina, mi sebeli okwangwa okulimukabo eniti mulibaka no lilata, sebeli nji Paulusi atwaliwe mu ndoo no kongola.
Cwale aba ana kukeela ba matulameno, konji oku shimbiwa ku Masole mulibaka no kutweba no nyangela.
Kakuli okupula nwaanu kame ana ku mukon̄anga, akuweleza nji, “Aibaiwe!”
Paulusi Yoku Sileleza Yonyene
Paulusi yoli beebi ni kwingenyekwa mu ndoo no kongola, sebeli wamba ku mwendisi no masole nji, “Kame ni kumbela okwamba nowe?” Woyo sebeli omwibanguta nji, “Kame olimukile okwamba Esigelike?”
Kana kasa wene Omwengepita, uya, ona liti omufilifili mu maywaa aya anabu ni kwetelela aibai alume ana ku kwana eikiti inee (4;000) okuta noo mu lihalaupa?”
Paulusi sebeli otambula nji, “Mene kame nili Omujuda, okutundelela ku Tasusi mu Silisia, omulenen̄i noutokwa, Kame ni kumbela kwa wene nji naambe kwaanu.”
Cwale aba ana ku mulumelela, sebeli oimana aba noku tinena, mi sebeli okobeta aanu ni Lyoko, cwale aba kuna kondoka onene tuu, sebeli wamba noo mu puo no Sihebelu nji,
